report:
Reviewed the full meta.reviews.complete_test_set claim, the associated review.rs implementation, and the complete added_or_removed_associations_invalidate_unchanged_saved_fragments test. This is source inspection; no behavior tests were rerun, and central execution is separate.

inventory iterates one canonical anchor at a time and creates one ReviewInput containing that claim and every site in rust.tests for that name. Each eligible site's full function source is sliced from its recorded span, metadata is added to tests, and a semantic test fragment is keyed by file/crate/target/Rust path. Conflicting spans for one semantic identity cause an ambiguity error rather than silently selecting a test. tests.sort/dedup gives deterministic metadata order, while the BTreeMap gives deterministic fragment order and deduplicates repeated associations to the same test. Distinct tests and targets remain distinct. Captured CorrespondenceIndex::record_tests is the eligibility producer: module-level built-in test functions in enabled standard harness targets, excluding ignored/conditionally ignored tests; accepted references append to the per-anchor vector. Captured evidence::placeholder_status preserves ordinary/TODO/N/A classification without filtering tests out of the review.

One review record is stored for the anchor, not one required proof per individual test. The prompt asks the reviewer to assess all requirements across the supplied implementation/test fragments, and inventory imposes no requirement that each test independently establish the complete claim. input_errors compares the complete saved/current tests metadata and initial fragments, so association-set changes invalidate the review even if an existing test body remains unchanged. Captured shared check wiring reports these review failures through ensure_valid.

The associated test starts with an approved one-test fixture, adds a second independently named test, and requires an anchor-specific test-associations diagnostic with the review-skill guidance. It then asserts the fresh input contains two tests, repeated starts yield identical ordered metadata, and the original test record remains exactly present. After recording the new set, removing the second test must again fail with the same association reason. The final implementation-association portion separately confirms adding a second implementation also invalidates the saved review and yields two current implementation entries; this supports the broader association regression without substituting for the explicit test-set assertions. Captured Fixture/TEST helpers create a real Cargo and Design workspace, call review::start/record and deserialize saved input; the key assertions are visible in the annotated body.

The implementation and test account for per-anchor scope, inclusion of the complete eligible set, deterministic ordering, association changes and collective rather than per-test claim coverage. There are no associated TODO or N/A entries. No concrete defect or additional necessary edit was found. No source changes are requested.
